text: Umananda Island Temple is a celebrated destination in Guwahati, Assam, renowned for its temples, nature, pilgrimage sites. Located in the historic and scenic region of Assam, it holds deep cultural, geographical, and architectural significance. Visitors explore this site to experience the authentic traditions, local atmosphere, and scenic beauty of Assam. The best time to plan a visit is generally October to April (dry season with vibrant festivals like Hornbill, Bihu, and Wangala). Regional cuisines and seasonal festivals enrich the journey.
best_time: October to April (dry season with vibrant festivals like Hornbill, Bihu, and Wangala)
